=== acl-gate ===
method a: smbd reads the ACL back; per-user NT ACLs under force user: no; usera, userb and userc got the same: yes
method b: smbd reads the ACL back; per-user NT ACLs under force user: no; usera, userb and userc got the same: yes
method c: smbd reads the ACL back; per-user NT ACLs under force user: no; usera, userb and userc got the same: yes
with an ACE of full rights for the folder owner S-1-22-1-1000: all three list, read and write: yes (smbd checks the token of the user it works as, not the session user's)
without force user (force group, inherit owner = unix only, a group-writable copy of the tree): per-user: yes
Gate: per-user NT ACLs under force user: no

=== acl-parameters ===
	acl claims evaluation = AD DC only
	kdc force enable rc4 weak session keys = No
	acl allow execute always = No
	acl check permissions = Yes
	acl flag inherited canonicalization = Yes
	acl group control = No
	acl map full control = Yes
	smbd force process locks = No
	force create mode = 0000
	force directory mode = 0000
	force group = 
	force printername = No
	force unknown acl user = No
	force user = 
	inherit acls = No
	inherit owner = no
	inherit permissions = No
	map acl inherit = No
	nt acl support = Yes
	acl_xattr:ignore system acls = yes
	force group = myUser
	force user = myUser
	acl_xattr:ignore system acls = yes
